maintenance_led.reason: Revenue comes from building and selling new homes to first-time and move-up buyers, not repair or replacement work.

publicly_funded.reason: Homes are bought by private consumers, financed by mortgages; Yardly rentals are also paid by private renters.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly by building and selling homes in its own communities; acquisitions are only occasional.

mission_critical.reason: Homebuyers choose among competing builders before purchase; no ongoing dependence or switching cost after one-time home sale.
